beats.summary: Dwight offers Schrute Farms as a wedding venue to Andy and Angela, who agree to the deal.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Congratulations on choosing Schrute Farms for your wedding.
Andy: Oh, thank the good Lord. Deal!

beats.summary: Michael humorously recounts his proposal story involving a diamond in a cheeseburger and a shooting star.

evidence.snippet: Michael: The ring, 10-carat diamond, pops out of her mouth, hits her shrimp cocktail, right onto her finger.

beats.summary: Michael announces intensive one-on-one sales retraining for Jim and Dwight after lunch.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Intensive one-on-one retraining will begin after lunch.
Andy: I am no longer the worst salesman in the office.

beats.summary: Dwight writes notarized letters warning clients about fraud related to lying on customer reviews, contrasting with Jim's friendly notes.
